title: Periwinkle Frost — Board Metrics Grid
description: A uniform grid of frosted KPI tiles over a soft periwinkle-violet gradient, purpose-built for board updates where each metric stands alone. Unlike dashboard templates that layer charts, each tile holds one number, one label, and an optional sparkline — keeping data scannable at room distance.
philosophy: This template exists for the moment a founder needs twelve eyes in a boardroom to read ARR growth, churn, and runway without squinting. It values data hierarchy above all else — the frosted glass is subordinate to the numeral, and the single accent color is reserved strictly for positive deltas, never decoration. It refuses overlapping cards, serif type that softens figures, and aesthetic flourishes that compete with the metrics. The room, the data, and the speaker take priority; the slide stays out of the way.
goodFor: Board-update decks showcasing 4–6 startup KPIs side by side
Quarterly investor reviews requiring scan-at-a-glance metric layouts
SaaS product reviews surfacing ARR, churn, and runway in one slide
60-second metric walk-throughs during Series A or B pitch meetings
avoidFor: Narrative slides requiring large hero imagery or editorial typography
Dense multi-chart comparisons needing more than one visual per tile
Consumer brand decks where warmth and personality are essential
Presentations with seven or more KPIs that cannot be distilled to a tight grid
author: harness

examples.promptCore: The slide reads as a quiet authority statement — one frosted panel suspended over a deep periwinkle-to-violet gradient that evokes pre-dawn boardroom stillness. Compositional rhythm is deliberately airy: vast negative space above and below the panel gives the title room to breathe without competing visual elements. The mood is institutional precision edging toward restraint — serious, investor-ready, and devoid of warmth signals or decorative energy. Avoid sparkle effects, layered translucency, and any flourish that could soften the executive register.

examples.layoutNotes: 12-column grid with an 8% outer margin on all sides; a single wide frosted-glass panel spans columns 2–11 and sits vertically centered at roughly the upper 45% of the slide height. Title and one-line subtitle live inside that panel, hierarchy established by scale contrast alone — no decorative rule lines. A minimal company or deck-date identifier anchors the lower-left corner outside the panel, flush to the margin. No header band; page number is suppressed on the title slide.

examples.promptCore: The slide should feel like a war-room dashboard projected in a silent boardroom — clinical, high-contrast, and instantly scannable from across a conference table. Six frosted glass tiles float over a cool periwinkle-violet gradient ground, each one a self-contained data capsule: one towering numeral, one quiet label, one optional miniature sparkline. The accent color appears exclusively on positive delta indicators, never as decoration, preserving its signal value. Avoid any softness, ornamentation, or visual texture that competes with the figures — the numbers are the hero, the frosted surface is merely their stage.

examples.layoutNotes: 12-column grid with a 6% outer margin on all sides; tiles arranged in a 2-row × 3-column formation occupying cols 1–12, with equal gutters between every tile so no card crowds another. Within each frosted tile: the primary metric numeral sits in the upper-center zone at dominant scale, the label anchors the bottom-left in a smaller weight, and the optional sparkline occupies the lower-right corner as a tertiary whisper. Slide number lives bottom-right outside the tile grid; no header band is used — the tile array is the entire slide.
